business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cloud Document Automation and E-Signature Authentication

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (national-level incorporation; no sub-state trade-register distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil law (Napoleonic system; unitary national jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–PRC Bilateral Investment Treaty; signed 30 May 1984; entered into force 19 March 1985
France–PRC Double Taxation Agreement with 2013 amending Protocol
EU–China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment; signed 30 December 2020; not yet in force
France–Hong Kong SAR Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement; signed 30 November 1997; in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq.; Loi n° 2016-1691 (Sapin II) of 9 December 2016; Décret n° 2017-1193 of 26 July 2017; Code de commerce articles L.123-1-2, R.123-7 et seq. and INPI/RNE implementing rules.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (since the EU Court of Justice restricted public BOR access, French UBO filings are accessible to competent supervisory authorities and authorized AML/CFT obliged entities on justified request)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each shareholder, director, legal representative and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (preferred; requires Apostille Convention membership) OR French consular legalization at the French Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and current corporate status of every non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR French consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or equivalent official extract confirming authority and current signatories of non-French corporate shareholders, together with resolutions/powers of attorney approving the French SAS incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry / notary of country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR French consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) of each UBO, director or legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR French consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory name/DOB/passport screening of each shareholder, director, legal representative, and UBO against EU/UN consolidated sanctions lists, OFAC SDN List (required because Stripe and card rails are USD/US payment routing), French domestic lists (TRACFIN/GU), and Politically Exposed Person databases. France applies CDD under Code monétaire et financier L.561-5 and PEP enhanced due diligence under L.561-10-2; enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP, non-resident high-risk jurisdiction, or unusual ownership structure.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and the French business register (RNE) available at data.inpi.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The constitutional documents, RCS filing, and statutory registers are in French (Loi Toubon 94-665). A foreign-script corporate name must be transliterated into Latin characters; where the desired name is foreign language, a French translation must be supplied for any contractual or mandatory disclosure to French counterparties. The name must not be misleading or contrary to public policy.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Avocat / Notaire / Huissier de justice / Expert-comptable / Médecin / Pharmacien
SA / SARL / EURL / Ltd / GmbH / AG if used inconsistently with the actual legal form
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a formal statutory pre-incorporation name reservation; the 30-day window is the customary holding period for an INPI/RNE availability search before filing. If the Guichet Unique rejects the name, the applicant receives reasons in writing. The filing may be corrected and resubmitted immediately through the same portal. For a substantive refusal by the RCS registrar, the applicant may petition the judge supervising the RCS (juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce et des sociétés) within 15 days of notification under Code de commerce procedure; no extension of the administrative name-clearance token is available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a standard-risk LegalTech SaaS subject to Code de commerce L.123-11-2: the SAS must hold a written domiciliation agreement with an authorized commercial domiciliation provider, the service must physically receive mail, be in France, and not be a PO box-only arrangement. A bare virtual mailbox without local substance is not acceptable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: approximately 3-5% annual probability for a standard-risk legal-tech SaaS; if TRACFIN or tax authorities open an AML/CFT or domiciliation probe, inspection probability increases above 10-15%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAS registration and RCS/INPI Guichet Unique filing fee (taxes de greffe and statutory registration duties)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (approximate EUR 120-130, converted at market rate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of incorporation notice in an approved legal announcements journal (annonce légale)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Selected journal d'annonces légales approved by the Prefecture

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of French-language SAS articles (statuts), including corporate governance provisions, classes of shares, and statutory UBO annex
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a boutique corporate legal adviser; no statutory cap

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of foreign corporate documents and shareholder identity documents into French
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Court-certified translator (traducteur expert) or sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per page; indexed to source language

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille/consular legalization of corporate and identity documents, plus UBO and PEP/sanctions screening file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary of origin / Ministry of Foreign Affairs / French consulate and AML/KYC compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Mix of fixed notarial tariffs and market compliance fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office domiciliation contract with physical mail reception (first-year commercial domiciliation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized commercial domiciliation company approved by the relevant Prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; approximately EUR 550 for the first year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Power-of-attorney legalization and corporate records preparation for post-incorporation corporate bank account opening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per separate legalization package

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title II, Chapter VII, Articles L. 227-1 to L. 227-32 (Société par Actions Simplifiée), together with Decree No. 2020-1541 on formalities via the INPI Guichet unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office (e.g., Greffe de Paris); centralized filing through the INPI Guichet unique (guichet-unique.inpi.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de la société (unified incorporation dossier) filed electronically through the INPI Guichet unique, culminating in the RCS registration extract (Extrait Kbis).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for an SAS; the Articles freely fix the amount, usually €1 or more as determined by the shareholders. At incorporation, at least 50% of cash subscriptions must be paid up and deposited with an authorized French bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations by way of a blocked temporary account; the balance may be paid within 5 years. In-kind contributions are fully paid upon issuance and require a statutory contributions auditor (commissaire aux apports) unless exempt. The depositary issues an Attestation de dépôt des fonds, which is included in the filing dossier and released on Kbis delivery.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the shareholders, having subscribed to the shares listed in the subscription schedule, ratify all share subscriptions and confirm that the share capital, fixed in the Articles, has been lawfully subscribed and paid up in accordance with Article L.227-2 of the French Commercial Code; (2) That the registered office shall be adopted at [Registered Office Address], France; (3) That the undersigned shall be appointed as President and Director-General, with full authority to bind the Company, open bank accounts and represent the Company before all authorities; (4) That the Chairman shall execute all incorporation filings, publish the legal notice and complete the Guichet unique registration. The resolution was unanimously approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare, Execute and Sign the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders; notarial participation optional unless in-kind or real-estate contributions require a notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in French, setting the corporate name, legal form SAS, duration (99 years), registered office, corporate purpose (cloud document automation, e-signature authentication, LegalTech SaaS solutions), share capital and class of shares, the President and corporate governance rules permitted by the free-determination principle of the SAS, and any powers of the Director-General. All shareholders must sign every page; non-resident shareholders may sign through a notarized power of attorney (procuration). If in-kind contributions are made, obtain the statutory auditor's valuation report and annex it.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association (Statuts) in French
Identity documents or passport copies of all founding shareholders
Notarized power of attorney for any signing proxy
Valuation report of statutory contributions auditor (if in-kind contribution)
Declaration of non-disqualification for managers and president
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a conformity query arises at the registry stage, execute a rectifying deed (avenant) or re-issue a compliant consolidated version of the Statuts before filing with the Guichet unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Paid-up Capital and Obtain Certificate of Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved French bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the 'société en formation'; transfer not less than 50% of the cash share capital; instruct the depositary to issue the Attestation de dépôt des fonds (certificate of capital deposit) certifying the exact amount received and the identity of the subscribers. The certificate forms part of the mandatory incorporation filings. Funds are released only upon presentation of the Extrait Kbis.
required_dossiers: Temporary account opening forms for the company in formation
Share subscription list (feuille de souscription)
Bank identification details of the depositary
Certificate of deposit of funds (Attestation de dépôt des fonds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the depositary raises KYC/AML questions, submit ultimate beneficial owner declarations and individual passport evidence; if the depositary refuses, transfer the funds to another approved French depositary and obtain a fresh certificate without new capitalization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish Legal Formation Notice (Avis de constitution) in an Authorized Legal Announcement Journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A legally authorized Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) in the department of the registered office, e.g., Les Affiches Parisiennes for Paris.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the statutory announcement containing the company name, legal form (SAS), share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, names of the president and director-general, and the registry (RCS) of filing. After publication, obtain the Attestation de parution as proof for the Guichet unique dossier.
required_dossiers: Completed announcement text (Avis de constitution)
Evidence of payment of the publication fee
Certification that no public offer of securities has been made
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL rejects the announcement for missing or inconsistent data, correct the text and republish on the next publication day; obtain a retro-dated Attestation de parution consistent with the corrected version.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Statutory Dossier Through the Single Window (Guichet unique de l'INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique (one-stop electronic portal); transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to guichet-unique.inpi.fr; complete the company incorporation form; upload the signed Statuts, certificate of capital deposit, Attestation de parution, declarations of corporate officers, registered-office consent or lease agreement, and identity documents; pay the fixed administrative fee online; submit and retain the electronic acknowledgement (récépissé) containing the assigned dossier number.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Association (Statuts signed)
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital deposit certificate)
Attestation de parution of the legal notice (JAL)
Declaration of conformity (AC) and non-disqualification of the president and director-general
Registered office attestation: lease (bail), domiciliation agreement, or ownership title
Copy of valid identity documents of all signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is suspended or rejected, the applicant is notified through the online personal space with a detailed deficiency list; upload corrected documents within 15 days to cure defects; in the event of a definitive rejection, file a new dossier with the corrected information and supporting proof.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Registration Extract (Extrait Kbis), SIREN/SIRET and Complete Post-filing Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE (automatic identifier assignment), and the Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the Extrait Kbis evidencing legal personality and RCS registration; collect the SIREN and SIRET identifiers automatically attributed by INSEE; open a definitively operational business bank account; if annual thresholds are exceeded and financing agreements require, appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes); register for the CFE (contribution foncière des entreprises) and the social regime of assimilated salary employees for the President; if applicable, ensure VAT registration is reflected in the taxpayer file.
required_dossiers: Récépissé of the Guichet unique submission
Extrait Kbis automatically issued by the Greffe
INSEE assignment notice with SIREN/SIRET
DGFIP fiscal registration confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is not issued within the SLA or contains incorrect data, submit a rectification request to the relevant Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; escalate through the registry's customer-service channel and, if necessary, apply before the judge delegated to supervise the RCS for an order to correct the entry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial license is required for ISIC 6201 digital services; DRIEETS (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités) holds general competence for workplace oversight of service enterprises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — the LegalTech SaaS activity operates under ordinary commercial registration (Kbis) without a pre-licensing regime, manufacturing permit, or regulated-sector concession.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) under the Code de l'environnement
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — pure cloud-data and software activity with no Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) and no material contraction of physical emissions; no EIA or environmental authorization is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to hosted software services; office premises must comply with municipal wastewater and solid-waste collection standards; any future private datacenter would be classified separately under ICPE-2915 and the EU Industrial Emissions Directive thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No dedicated clearance certificate is mandatory, but office premises must comply with the Code du travail and the Code de la construction et de l'habitation: emergency exits and fire-safety equipment, electrical installation verification, accessibility requirements, structural load safety, and the occupational health registration with the CARSAT; if the office is open to the public, the local fire-safety commission (Commission de sécurité) issues the ERP classification for 5th-category premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Domestic French entities register for SIREN/SIRET identification number with INSEE and obtain VAT identification number (FR followed by 11-digit SIREN) through the DGFiP portal; foreign entities must engage a French fiscal representative and follow specific registration procedures
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Absence of US-style check-the-box elections; however, specific hybrid mismatch relief elections may be available under the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD)

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €36,300 annual turnover threshold for mandatory registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) for all B2B transactions since 1 October 2024, requiring digital stamping and transmission to tax authorities via approved platforms or APIs

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for 0% VAT rate on exports of goods outside the European Union or provision of offshore services, requiring proof that the transaction is completed outside the EU
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'Exportation en Douane - DAU)
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Retrospective audits by DGFiP may result in clawback of erroneously zero-rated VAT, imposition of 40% penalties, interest charges, and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France; foreign-exchange policy is principally governed by European Union law, the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, French monetary and financial legislation, and the French Ministry for the Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty through the Directorate-General of the Treasury.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France uses the euro and has full current-account and capital-account convertibility within the European Union and the euro area. There is no general French exchange-control approval for receiving capital, paying suppliers, repatriating dividends, servicing shareholder loans, or converting euros into foreign currencies. Transfers remain subject to bank anti-money-laundering, counter-terrorist-financing, sanctions, beneficial-ownership, tax-compliance, and transaction-monitoring controls. Dividend distributions require distributable profits and applicable corporate approvals; withholding tax, treaty relief, beneficial-owner evidence, and French tax reporting may affect net remittance. Interest, royalties, management fees, and other related-party payments require transfer-pricing support, corporate-benefit evidence, and applicable withholding-tax analysis. Transactions involving sanctioned jurisdictions, restricted counterparties, protected strategic sectors, or unusual payment structures may require enhanced review, blocking, reporting, or governmental authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory requirement to repatriate export proceeds to France and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Export proceeds may generally be held in euros or foreign currencies and may be collected through French, European, or foreign accounts, subject to accounting, tax, customs, sanctions, AML, and statistical-reporting requirements. For intra-EU supplies and exports outside the European Union, the company must retain commercial invoices, contracts, transport evidence, customs records, VAT documentation, and proof of payment. Banks may request transaction-purpose information and supporting documents, and Banque de France or other authorities may require statistical information under applicable reporting frameworks. No universal statutory collection deadline or compulsory currency conversion deadline applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and the relevant Crédit Agricole regional bank
BPCE group, including Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne institutions

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for payment collection and operating flows; low as the sole French corporate banking platform for a newly incorporated SAS. A regulated European Union electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide accounts, payment services, card acquiring, SEPA transfers, and foreign-exchange services through passporting or local authorization. It does not automatically provide a French bank account, bank deposits protected by the French deposit-guarantee scheme, capital-deposit escrow accepted for incorporation, lending, cash-management depth, or unrestricted access to all clearing products. Stripe and other payment facilitators may be used for customer card payments subject to merchant underwriting, prohibited-business rules, reserve requirements, chargeback controls, PSD2-related allocation of responsibilities, AML screening, and settlement-account verification. Offshore unregulated digital wallets should not be used for capital escrow, tax remittances, payroll, or material treasury balances.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a universal rule that every director must appear physically at a bank branch. Remote onboarding may be permitted, particularly where the bank accepts qualified electronic identification and complete corporate documentation. In practice, a bank may require a video interview, certified identification, a French or European residential address for relevant persons, a local contact, an in-person meeting, or notarized and apostilled documents, especially where shareholders, directors, or ultimate beneficial owners are non-resident, the ownership chain is complex, the business is newly incorporated, or expected transaction flows are cross-border. The SAS must identify and maintain accurate beneficial-owner information and comply with the French register and bank-record requirements. Bank acceptance remains discretionary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder, director, or ultimate beneficial owner with an opaque ownership chain or nominee arrangement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current articles of association; extrait Kbis or equivalent registration evidence; complete ownership chart to natural-person ultimate beneficial owners; shareholder register; passports and proof of address; corporate registries for upstream entities; board or shareholder resolutions; beneficial-owner declaration; tax-residency self-certifications; and notarized, apostilled, certified, or translated documents where requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No demonstrated French operating substance for a newly formed LegalTech SaaS company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan; product and service description; website and customer terms; software-development and hosting contracts; office or registered-address evidence; employment or contractor documentation; projected monthly inflows and outflows; target-market analysis; customer and supplier geographies; invoices or signed contracts; and a written explanation of why France is the operating or holding location.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-volume card receipts, payment-facilitator settlements, or rapid movement of funds through multiple jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-flow diagram; acquiring and processor agreements; expected transaction volumes and average ticket size; chargeback and refund policy; customer onboarding and fraud controls; sanctions and screening procedures; reconciliation process; settlement-account ownership evidence; source-of-funds memorandum; and sample invoices and customer contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection or shareholder loan from a foreign group entity with unclear economic purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed subscription agreement or loan agreement; shareholder or board approval; funds-flow schedule; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence; audited or management accounts of the remitter; ownership proof; tax and transfer-pricing analysis; payment instruction showing capital or loan purpose; and evidence of capitalization or registration in the SAS accounting records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments involving sanctioned, high-risk, or poorly documented countries, counterparties, or intermediaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty due-diligence file; beneficial-owner verification; sanctions-screening results; contract and invoice; shipping or service-delivery evidence; end-use and end-user statement; license or authorization where applicable; bank routing details; and documented escalation and approval under the company's sanctions policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Virtual assets, cash-intensive activity, unexplained third-party payments, or personal-account use
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written policy prohibiting personal accounts and unauthorized third-party settlement; source-of-funds records; wallet and exchange compliance evidence if legally relevant; transaction-level reconciliation; independent accounting review; director certification; and a commitment to use regulated financial institutions and segregated corporate accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent revenue model, legal-contract automation claims, or possible provision of regulated legal services
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed product architecture; customer use cases; terms identifying the service as software rather than legal advice where applicable; professional-liability and cybersecurity insurance; data-processing agreements; licensing analysis; customer contracts; pricing schedule; and legal memorandum confirming that the activities do not constitute unauthorized regulated professional services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-residency, CRS, FATCA, VAT, or beneficial-owner information inconsistent with account records
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French tax identification and registration records; VAT registration where applicable; CRS self-certification; FATCA status documentation; tax-residency certificates; corporate income-tax details; organizational chart; financial statements; and prompt written correction of any discrepancy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route equity through a regulated French or European bank into a dedicated capital-deposit account before SAS incorporation or capital increase, or into the SAS operational account after incorporation and registration of the capital increase. The remittance should identify the legal nature of the payment as share capital, share premium, shareholder loan, or other documented funding; use the bank's applicable SEPA or international-payment purpose code; name the SAS as beneficiary; and include the shareholder resolution, subscription agreement, loan agreement where relevant, and invoice or corporate-purpose documentation. The bank should verify sender identity, ultimate beneficial ownership, source of funds, sanctions status, and consistency with the corporate documents. For non-euro transfers, use a regulated correspondent-bank chain and retain the SWIFT payment confirmation, exchange-rate record, fee record, and beneficiary-credit evidence. Foreign investment in a protected French strategic activity may require prior notification or authorization; ordinary cloud document automation and e-signature software is not ordinarily subject to sectoral foreign-investment approval, but the activity and technology should be screened against the current French protected-sector rules. Record the transaction in the SAS ledger and financial accounts and complete applicable Banque de France, tax, accounting, and statistical reports.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments within the SEPA area, subject to bank limits and sanctions screening. Use SWIFT cross-border payments, commonly evidenced by an MT103 or its ISO 20022 equivalent, for non-SEPA or non-euro suppliers; retain the payment confirmation, invoice, contract, beneficiary verification, and purpose information. Use commercial documentary letters of credit, standby letters of credit, documentary collections, or open-account payments according to counterparty risk and trade terms. A commercial LC should specify issuing and confirming banks, governing rules such as UCP 600 where agreed, required documents, expiry, shipment or service conditions, discrepancy procedures, charges, and sanctions clauses. For SaaS services, payment is generally supported by contracts, invoices, service-acceptance evidence, and subscription records rather than shipping documents. Maintain segregation of duties, dual approval, beneficiary-change call-back controls, invoice matching, sanctions screening, and reconciliation. Payments of dividends, interest, royalties, and related-party service fees require separate corporate, tax, withholding, transfer-pricing, and distributable-profit analysis.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with a regulated bank or eligible investment firm, used to hedge documented forecast or committed foreign-currency receivables, payables, or funding exposures and subject to suitability, confirmations, collateral, accounting, and counterparty limits.

Non-deliverable forwards where the relevant currency or jurisdiction uses restricted convertibility or where settlement is contractually made in a reference currency; the instrument must be offered by an appropriately regulated counterparty and supported by a genuine underlying exposure and sanctions-compliant settlement.

Currency swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for documented funding or balance-sheet exposures, subject to counterparty credit approval, ISDA or equivalent documentation, collateral terms, valuation, and applicable European Market Infrastructure Regulation requirements.

Foreign-exchange options, collars, and participating forwards may be used where the company understands premium, contingent-obligation, leverage, and accounting risks; execution should be limited to hedging rather than speculative trading.

For a French SAS, derivatives with financial counterparties may trigger EMIR clearing, reporting, margin, risk-mitigation, legal-entity-identifier, and recordkeeping obligations depending on instrument, counterparty classification, and transaction status. MiFID II conduct and appropriateness or suitability requirements may also apply. Treasury policy should prohibit uncovered speculation, establish board-approved limits, document hedge relationships under applicable accounting standards, and retain confirmations and valuation records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing (Dépôt des Comptes Annuels): balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, notes, and management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés via INPI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of fiscal year-end (calendar-year SAS: 31 July); shareholders' approval within 6 months of year-end, filing within 1 month of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing: fine up to EUR 4,500 for legal entities and EUR 1,500 for individuals; coercive fine by commercial court; continued non-compliance triggers administrative strike-off (radiation) from RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Publication of approved annual accounts in BODACC (Bulletin Officiel des Annonces Civiles et Commerciales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: BODACC published by the Commercial Court Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month of filing the annual accounts (calendar-year SAS: 31 August)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Publication fee unpaid renders the deposit incomplete and non-registered; effective filing deemed absent, attracting the same late-filing fines and RCS strike-off risk

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Déclaration de résultats: Form 2065-SD and annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – French Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Second business day following 1 May for calendar-year taxpayers; within 3 months of fiscal year-end for off-calendar fiscal years
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty: 10% of tax due plus 0.20% monthly late-payment interest; penalty increases to 40% after formal notice and 80% for fraudulent concealment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Local business tax (CFE – Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises): Form 1330-CFE declaration and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – Municipal Tax Collection Office (Service des Impôts des Particuliers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration due by 3 May of the levy year; single-installment payment no later than 15 December of the levy year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment penalty plus 0.20% monthly interest; enforced recovery (titre de recouvrement) after 31 December; minimum CFE of approximately EUR 226 is due even with zero turnover

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO register declaration and confirmation (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS through INPI formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership; annually re-affirmed in tandem with the annual accounts deposit; register must remain permanently accurate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Article L.123-33 C. com.: up to 6 months' imprisonment and EUR 7,500 fine per officer; exclusion from public procurement; false declarations recorded at RCS and may lead to strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a Commissaire aux Comptes (Statutory Auditor) when the SAS exceeds 2 of 3 thresholds at fiscal year-end: balance-sheet total above EUR 4,000,000; net turnover above EUR 8,000,000; average workforce above 50 employees (Articles L.823-1 and D.823-1 C. com.). Sub-threshold SAS may appoint a voluntary auditor at shareholder request or investor covenant.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory individual accounts must follow French GAAP (PCG – Plan Comptable Général, Règlement ANC 2016-07); consolidated accounts of groups may adopt IFRS as endorsed by the EU.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must file any change in beneficial owners within 30 days via INPI (formalité 3185); where no change occurs, the UBO data filed with the annual accounts deposit serves as the annual confirmation. The officer must attest accuracy under penalty of Article L.123-33 C. com. (EUR 7,500 fine and 6 months' imprisonment for false or omitted declarations).

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 162 - USD 810 per annum (EUR 150 - EUR 750) for commercial domiciliation of a SAS
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,860 - USD 16,200 (EUR 4,500 - EUR 15,000) for a small or mid-size LegalTech SaaS subject to voluntary or compulsory audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25.0% standard French corporate income tax rate for fiscal years ending on or after 1 January 2022; 15.0% reduced rate applies to the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit per fiscal year for qualifying SMEs (turnover below EUR 10,000,000, fully paid-up capital, and ownership by natural persons or SME-qualifying entities).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 3.3% social solidarity surcharge (contribution sociale sur les benefices) applies to companies with turnover exceeding EUR 7,630,000 and annual CIT exceeding EUR 763,000, producing an all-in statutory rate of 25.83%. Research tax credit (CIR): 30% of eligible R&D expenditure up to EUR 100,000,000, then 5% beyond. Innovation tax credit (CII): 20% of eligible innovation expenses for SMEs. Young Innovative Company (JEI) regime: full CIT exemption for the first 3 years of activity and 50% exemption for the following 2 years, subject to payroll and R&D-intensity conditions. CVAE (Cotisation sur la Valeur Ajoutee des Entreprises) abolished as of 1 January 2024. Territorial economic contribution (CFE) remains based on the rental value of French business premises. B2B SaaS subscription revenue is treated as service income subject to French VAT at 20% under the reverse-charge mechanism; no withholding tax applies on ordinary service fees received by the SAS.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward with no statutory time limit, but annual utilisation capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; alternative 3-year carryback (report en arriere) capped at EUR 1,000,000 of taxable profit, generating a creditable tax asset.
